updates.text: 3 partners said yes (MSBL, WNBF, Head of the Schuylkill). About 34 partner emails sent; 13 organisations replied. Tredict offered API access, and Concept2 sent Logbook API key steps.
Paid items still open: HOSR table $300, WNBF booth $250, RRCA expo table $1,200, the Search-1 ad, and Nocturnal (vendor). From now on Marksom pitches only no-cost exchanges.

1 call booked: Nocturnal, Mon 12 Oct, 2 pm EDT. It is a paid engineering vendor, not a partner, so keep it short. Momentum (data integration, no cost), Ohio State Triathlon Club and ANZER USA asked for calls.
The early emails linked a non-Vybe calendar. 22 in-thread corrections are drafted with John on CC, and the Growth Scout agent is still sending from the same inbox.
Polar now sells the Loop as a screen-free, subscription-free band (armband added 7 Oct). Oura became the Dodgers' official health wearable (9 Sep). All 45 deals were re-checked on 10 Oct.
133 sessions (601 the week before), 57 from the US. 4 waitlist signups, up from 1. Visits drifted to about 10 a day once the boosted posts stopped.
First Google clicks: 6 clicks from 122 impressions (0 from 36 the week before). The homepage, /band and the WHOOP alternative page earned them.
1,088 followers and 8 posts. Reels reach far more people than images: 426 for the 1 Oct Reel, against 12 to 54 for images.
$161.07 spent ($41.08 the week before). Search-1 still runs at about $8 a day. The goal is partnerships, not spend, so pausing it is recommended.
